claims.text: The GPS trace for this trip records 26.84 km driven between the first fix at 15:18:40 and the last at 15:59:40 against a booked optimal of 20.7 km on the trip record, an excess of 6.14 km. POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km the governing measurement and forbids citing the rounded trip_record.actual_distance_km for the threshold test, so the excess is 6.14 km and 29.66% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 gates are cleared — greater than 20% of optimal and greater than 0.8 km absolute — and the deviation is ESTABLISHED on this trip's own evidence.

The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07. It carries 247 fixes at a 10 second sample interval, coverage_pct 100, an empty gaps array and max_gap_sec 0.0, so none of limbs (a) to (c) of POL-RD-07 is met — there is no gap above 90 seconds, no straight-line jump above 500 m and no sustained interval above 30 seconds. The deviation may therefore be established on the trace alone, and the POL-RD-10(3) escalation route is not engaged.

The driver's own message in the chat log, sent at 15:32:50, reads 'I took the longer route to collect the other passenger', and his counterparty statement adds 'I collected another passenger.' That is a driver admission on the face of the record, and it is also independent corroboration of the route of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names — so even had the trace been impaired, the deviation would have been carried by an artifact other than the trace.

POL-RD-04 is unavailable on this record. The chat log contains a single message, sent by the DRIVER at 15:32:50, fourteen minutes after the trip started at 15:18:40, and its waypoint_hint is null. There is no rider instruction anywhere in the bundle, so limb (a) of POL-RD-04 fails at the outset and the timing and place-specificity tests need not even be reached. No part of the excess is excluded as rider-requested.

I disclose that the bundle's only traffic advisory artifact, EV-ADVIS-00718-01, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and has no payload; its absence is itself citable. No advisory covers the optimal corridor in this window, so POL-RD-03 cannot be run. The point is academic in any event, because the driver asserts no external traffic cause at all — he attributes the route to the second passenger and states he has 'no traffic advisory or rider instruction excusing that route'. Because he names no advisory evidence ID, this is a gap in the bundle rather than an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, and POL-RD-10(5) does not fire; under POL-RD-13(2) the deviation stands at the measured figure and POL-RD-02 runs against the booked optimal route.

POL-RD-12 gives the rider nothing here, for the simple reason that it does not apply. trip_record.vehicle_type is RYDE_X and solo_optimal_distance_km is null; this was a solo metered trip, not a platform-matched pooled itinerary. The matched-itinerary baseline does not displace the booked optimal of 20.7 km, and the distance driven to collect the second passenger is not excluded from the excess.

The rider's POL-RD-08 burden is discharged. The three artifacts describe the same trip: trip_id TRP-00718 appears on the trip record, the trace and the fare breakdown, and the 15:18:40 first fix matches trip_record.started_at. An excess above the POL-RD-01 threshold is measured from an unimpaired trace. The burden has shifted to the driver, and he points to no artifact and to no clause among POL-RD-03, POL-RD-04, POL-RD-05, POL-RD-11 and POL-RD-12 — his own statement is that he has no excuse for the route. The burden is not discharged.

The fare is METERED, so the remedy is arithmetic rather than discretionary. Under POL-RD-02: recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 20.7 + 0.28 x 31) x 1.0 surge, the multiplier being read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier and nowhere else, + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP/tolls + 0 waiting time - 0 promo = 28.805. Charged_total is 36.18, so the refund is 36.18 - 28.805 = 7.375 before rounding, payable as SGD 7.40 rounded up to the nearest 0.05. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor, and at 20.4% of charged_total it falls far short of the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome the rider asks for is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 7.40.

Nothing is added on top of the POL-RD-02 figure, and nothing may be. fare_breakdown shows no ERP gantries charged (off-route and on-route totals both 0.00) and an airport_surcharge of 0.0 on a trip that ends at, rather than originates at, an airport, so no POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity correction arises. POL-RD-09(1) would in any event forbid adding off-route ERP to the POL-RD-02 refund, because it is already comprehended in charged_total less the recomputed fare. The refund is the distance-and-time recomputation and nothing else.

I do not put POL-RD-06 in issue, and I do not claim its uplift. The deviation is not MATERIAL: 29.66% of optimal is below the 50% limb and 6.14 km is below the 8.0 km limb. Consulted anyway, the driver profile shows deviation_flags_90d of 0 against completed_trips_90d of 250 — a ratio of 0, far below the 0.05 test in POL-RD-06 — so no repeat pattern is established and neither the FULL_REFUND uplift nor the conduct referral is available. The rider's remedy is the POL-RD-02 partial of SGD 7.40, not a full refund of the 36.18 charged.

The contested amount is the SGD 36.18 platform distance-and-time charge on the fare breakdown — the line the rider asks to have recomputed. The alleged SGD 40 cash demand appears nowhere in the fare_breakdown, and the rider expressly does not seek it. POL-RD-02 refunds only what is traceable to a line of that ledger, so the cash allegation plays no part in the arithmetic and does not inflate the figure either way.

Every artifact the ruling needs is clean and full weight: the trip record, the GPS trace, the chat log and the fare breakdown are all COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0. The only impaired artifact is the MISSING advisory EV-ADVIS-00718-01 at weight 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, on which no finding rests. Under POL-GEN-02(2) the confidence cap on the deciding facts is therefore 1.0, and the POL-RD-10(1) confidence-floor escalation is not engaged.

The trace measures 26.84 km against the 20.7 km optimal, an excess of 6.14 km or 29.66% — below BOTH POL-RD-01 materiality gates, the 8.0 km absolute gate and the 50% proportional gate. Whatever the size of the deviation, it is therefore not a MATERIAL deviation, and the POL-RD-06 consequences that attach only to a material deviation are not engaged on this record.

The driver_profile shows deviation_flags_90d of 0 across completed_trips_90d of 250 — a ratio of 0.00. Both limbs of the POL-RD-06 pattern test fail: fewer than 3 flags in the trailing 90 days, and a ratio well under 0.05. No repeat-deviation pattern is established, so there is no resolution of a finely balanced record against the driver, no FULL_REFUND uplift on the remedy, and no driver-conduct referral.

The remedy under POL-RD-02 is arithmetic, not discretionary. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 20.7 + 0.28 x 31) x the fare_breakdown surge_multiplier of 1.0, plus the 0.80 platform fee, plus zero ERP/tolls, plus zero waiting fee, less zero promo = 28.805 against a charged_total of 36.18. The refund is therefore 36.18 - 28.805 = 7.375, rounded UP to SGD 7.40. That is 20.4% of the amount charged, far below the 90% share that would license a FULL_REFUND, and roughly one-fifth of the SGD 36.18 the rider contests.

Nothing is added on top of that figure. The fare_breakdown carries no ERP gantries, no tolls and no airport surcharge — erp_lines total is 0.00 — so POL-RD-09 contributes nothing on this trip. Off-route ERP is in any event already comprehended within the POL-RD-02 recomputation and must never be stacked onto it, so no separate pass-through correction of any size is available.

The alleged SGD 40 cash demand is supported by no artifact at all: the fare_breakdown contains no cash line, and the single-message chat log contains no demand of any kind. An assertion that cites no evidence ID carries no weight and is discarded under POL-RD-08, and the rider's own filing does not seek the cash back — so it cannot inflate or complicate the monetary ruling, which stays on the fare_breakdown lines alone.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this was a solo RYDE_X metered trip (TRP-00718) from West Grove to an airport-bound destination, and the distance-and-time charge on the fare breakdown (EV-FARE-00718) is the only sum in issue.

DEVIATION ESTABLISHED. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00718) records 26.84 km driven; the booked optimal distance on the trip record (EV-TRIP-00718) is 20.7 km. POL-RD-01 makes the trace figure governing and bars use of the rounded trip_record.actual_distance_km for the threshold test, so the excess is 6.14 km, or 29.66% of optimal. Both establishment tests pass (above 0.8 km and above 20%), so the deviation is established. The trace is not impaired under POL-RD-07 — 247 fixes at a 10-second interval, no gaps (max_gap_sec 0.0) and no jumps — so it carries the finding on its own; the driver's own chat message at 15:32:50 ('I took the longer route to collect the other passenger') and his counterparty statement ('I collected another passenger … I have no traffic advisory or rider instruction excusing that route') independently admit the same route.

NO EXCUSE APPLIES. There is no traffic advisory in the bundle (EV-ADVIS-00718-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), and the driver asserts no traffic cause, so POL-RD-03 cannot run and POL-RD-13(2) leaves the excess at the measured figure. POL-RD-04 fails at its first limb: the only chat message is from the driver, not the rider, and its waypoint_hint is null. There was no pickup or dropoff amendment (POL-RD-05), the fare model is METERED rather than UPFRONT_QUOTE (POL-RD-11), and this was not a pooled itinerary — vehicle_type RYDE_X with solo_optimal_distance_km null — so POL-RD-12 does not apply and nothing is excluded for the second passenger.

THE REFUND. Under POL-RD-02: recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 × 20.7 + 0.28 × 31) × 1.0, the surge multiplier being read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP/tolls + 0 waiting fee − 0 promo = SGD 28.805. Charged_total is SGD 36.18, so the refund is 36.18 − 28.805 = SGD 7.375, rounded UP to SGD 7.40. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and well below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 7.40. Nothing is added on top: the fare breakdown carries no ERP or toll lines and no airport surcharge, and POL-RD-09(1) would in any event forbid stacking off-route ERP onto the POL-RD-02 figure.

NO MATERIALITY, NO PATTERN, NO REFERRAL. The deviation is not MATERIAL (6.14 km is below the 8.0 km limb and 29.66% below the 50% limb), so POL-RD-06 is not engaged. Consulted for completeness, the driver profile shows deviation_flags_90d of 0 across completed_trips_90d of 250 — no repeat pattern — so neither the FULL_REFUND uplift nor a driver-conduct referral is available. No other clause produces a referral, so the referrals list is empty.

THE CASH ALLEGATION. The alleged SGD 40 cash demand appears in no artifact — not on the fare breakdown, and not in the single chat message — and the rider expressly does not seek it. It therefore forms no part of this ruling. Separately, the driver's collection of a second passenger on a solo trip is a service matter this policy's clauses do not reach; if the rider wishes to pursue it, that belongs with support rather than a route-deviation refund.

CONFIDENCE. Every artifact carrying the deciding facts — the trace, the trip record and the fare breakdown — is COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and the POL-RD-10(1) confidence floor is not engaged. No POL-RD-10 escalation trigger fires.
